case_title.reason: Matches the judgment's caption, Digamber Vaishna & Anr. v. State of Chhattisgarh.

number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants, Digamber Vaishnav and Girdhari Vaishnav, are named as accused.

accused_gender.reason: Appellant No.1 is referred to with male pronouns, and the accused are male by implication.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No wealth or class statement about the accused appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: All five victims are women (Shri Bai, Subhadra, Kondi, Amrika, Mala Bai).

victim_age.reason: Only PW-8's age (9) is given; victims' ages are not stated.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victims is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victims is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Not stated (court found acquaintance not sufficiently shown; PW-9 hearsay said accused came to see Kondi)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: He has referred to a boy accompanying appellant No.1, which is not sufficient to show the acquaintance.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The judgment describes a claimed visit to see Kondi via telephone hearsay, which the value omits.

offence_category.reason: Charges concern murder under s.302 IPC with robbery under s.394.

statutory_provisions.reason: Judgment cites ss.302/34 and 394/34 of the Penal Code.

weapon.reason: No weapon is identified; death was by strangulation, which is a method rather than a weapon.

evidence_type.reason: Judgment lists child witness, s.27 recoveries, fingerprint, FSL, motive and last seen as circumstantial evidence.

confession.correct_value: Section 27 disclosure statements by the accused leading to recoveries; the judgment does not discuss them as a confession
confession.quote: Memorandum statement of the accused Digamber was recorded as per his dictation
confession.reason: Disclosures and recoveries are correct, but the claim that the Court did not treat them as a confession is not in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Trial court found five deaths by strangulation; the Supreme Court weighed no aggravating factor.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Sessions Court imposed death under s.302/34 and ten years RI with Rs.500 fine under s.394/34.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court affirmed the death sentence, dismissed the appeals and answered the reference.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court allowed the appeals and acquitted the appellants.

offence_finally_established.reason: Appellants were acquitted of all offences, so none is established.

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence stands after acquittal, so 'none' fits the schema.

imprisonment_years.reason: No final fixed-term sentence exists after acquittal.

fine_rs.reason: No final fine survives the acquittal.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary covers incident, investigation and evidence without names, outcome or court proceedings.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment range.

attempt_completion.reason: Five deaths were caused, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Post-mortem found asphyxia due to strangulation and homicidal deaths of all five.

number_of_offences.reason: Two sections charged (302/34, 394/34); none finally upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: Theft was not proved; cash and anklet were alleged stolen but not traced to the deceased.

premeditation_planning.reason: The judgment makes no finding on premeditation or planning.

motive.reason: Robbery was alleged as motive and the Court found it unsubstantiated.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court accepted no evidence as sufficient; chain of circumstances was found incomplete.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Child witness PW-8 found unreliable: not eyewitness, inconsistent, contradicted by PWs 1, 3, 10. PW-9 deposed only on telephone call. PWs 4 and 5 contradicted each other; PW-2 and seizure memos contradictory.
witness_credibility.reason: Omits the PWs 4 and 5 contradiction; PW-9 'hearsay' is a paraphrase of a telephone-call basis.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused allegedly disclosed and produced concealed articles (cash, anklet, motorcycle) under s.27; the Court found these recoveries unreliable
post_offence_conduct.quote: he has kept the motorcycle at the house of Girdhari and Rs.3000/- and anklet (pair patti) was kept in his house
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment records s.27 disclosures and concealed articles, so 'Not stated' misses this recorded conduct.

custody_duration.reason: The judgment does not state time spent in custody.

trial_duration.reason: All dates listed match the judgment: offence, trial judgment, High Court and Supreme Court.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel for appellants and State match the judgment's appearance list.

investigation_status.reason: FIR in Crime No.430/12, chargesheet filed and 14 witnesses examined are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Lists unexamined witnesses, articles left at scene and unexplained reporting delay, all noted by the Court.

appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court affirmance and Supreme Court acquittal are accurately described.

prosecution_argument.reason: Respondent counsel supported the lower courts' judgments and sought dismissal of the appeals.

defence_argument.reason: Matches Nagamuthu's submissions on delay, PW-8, recoveries, PW-9, fingerprints and last seen.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Burden of proof, circumstantial evidence conditions, two-view rule, child witness and last seen principles are all applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All cited precedents with citations appear in the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentence is imposed by the Supreme Court, so not applicable.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no aggravating factors.

other_sentence_order.reason: Orders set aside lower judgments and directed release, as stated in the operative paragraph.
